svg.title: Outer Sluiceway — Bronze floodgates and exposed waterworks on driven piles
svg.desc: A long sluice alternates dry maintenance bays and visible water channels. Tool chests, pipe bridges and hoist platforms connect the grounding straps to an upper service road.
